description: Retrieve verified all-time or modern-era (post-1992) major trophy honours across 34 English & European clubs, or compare two clubs head-to-head (e.g. 'liverpool-vs-manchester-united').

club_or_duel.description: Optional club slug (e.g. 'liverpool', 'real-madrid') or rivalry duel slug (e.g. 'liverpool-vs-manchester-united', 'arsenal-vs-chelsea').

include_super_cups.description: Whether to include Community Shields, UEFA Super Cups, and FIFA Club World Cups in total honours.

name: get_club_trophies
title: Club Trophy Honours & Rivalry Duels
